spec.description: Time (24 h) and date from the browser's clock, current weather, the next 24 hours in 3-hour steps and today and the next four days from the Open-Meteo forecast API (no key), at the plant's coordinates (vault_open_meteo_location_raggendorf). The browser fetches it directly, at most every 15 minutes (every minute while no data has arrived), whatever the dashboard refresh; faded with the error in the footer when the last update failed. Rain shows the probability from 10 % up and the daily amount.
